dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 오늘 굳이 멀리까지 가서 먹어야 할까? 퇴근길도 꽤 막힐 텐데.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Do we really need to go all the way across town for dinner? Traffic will be rough after work.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 딱히 당기는 메뉴가 없으면 근처에서 해결하자. 새로 생긴 곳도 있더라.
dialogue_lines.en_text: If nothing in particular sounds good, let's get something nearby. I saw a new place just opened.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 메뉴 좀 확인해 볼게. 파스타 말고도 선택지가 있으면 좋겠어.
dialogue_lines.en_text: I'll check the menu. It'd be nice to have a few options besides pasta.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 샐러드랑 생선 요리도 있네. 오늘은 가볍게 먹고 싶었어.
dialogue_lines.en_text: They have salads and fish, too. I feel like having something lighter tonight.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 좋다. 금요일인데 예약까지 굳이 해야 할까?
dialogue_lines.en_text: That works. Do we really need to make a reservation on a Friday?

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 혹시 모르니까 자리 있는지 내가 전화해서 확인할게.
dialogue_lines.en_text: I'll call and check if they have a table, just in case.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 난 생선으로 할게. 오늘은 너무 무거운 음식은 별로야.
dialogue_lines.en_text: I'll get the fish. I don't feel like having anything too heavy tonight.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 난 수프랑 샐러드로 할게. 나눠 먹을 것도 하나 시키자.
dialogue_lines.en_text: I'll go with the soup and salad. Let's get something to share, too.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 배부르면 디저트는 건너뛰고 커피로 입가심하자.
dialogue_lines.en_text: If we're full, we can skip dessert and just get coffee to finish.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 완벽해. 그럼 내가 예약하고 시간 맞춰 갈게.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Perfect. I'll make the reservation, and we can meet there on time.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 너 요즘 민지랑 자주 보더라. 둘이 썸타는 거야?
dialogue_lines.en_text: You and Minji have been hanging out a lot lately. Are you two seeing each other?

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 아직 그런 사이는 아니야. 그냥 서로 알아가는 중이지.
dialogue_lines.en_text: We're not quite there yet. We're just getting to know each other.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 다들 벌써 눈치챈 것 같던데? 같이 있으면 표정이 달라.
dialogue_lines.en_text: I think everyone has caught on. You look different when you're together.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 그렇게 티가 났어? 괜히 꽁냥꽁냥한다고 놀림받겠네.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Was it that obvious? Now everyone's going to tease us for being all lovey-dovey.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 놀리는 게 아니라 보기 좋다는 거야. 너도 편해 보이고.
dialogue_lines.en_text: I'm not teasing. It's nice to see, and you seem more at ease.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 그 친구랑 있으면 말이 없어도 편하긴 해.
dialogue_lines.en_text: I feel comfortable around her, even when we don't have much to say.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 그럼 천천히 가 봐. 괜히 서두를 필요 없잖아.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Then take it slow. There's no need to rush into anything.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 맞아. 이번 주말에 같이 전시 보러 가기로 했어.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Exactly. We made plans to see an exhibit together this weekend.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 잘됐네. 다음에 만나면 어떻게 됐는지 꼭 얘기해 줘.
dialogue_lines.en_text: That's great. Give me the full story next time we meet.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 알았어. 아직은 우리끼리만 알고 있어 줘.
dialogue_lines.en_text: I will. Just keep it between us for now.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 새 파운데이션 써 봤어? 오후인데도 피부가 꽤 뽀송해 보여.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Have you tried a new foundation? Your skin still looks pretty matte this late in the day.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 응, 지성 피부용으로 바꿨어. 전에는 점심만 지나면 번들거렸거든.
dialogue_lines.en_text: I switched to one for oily skin. I used to get shiny by lunchtime.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 커버력은 어때? 트러블도 잘 가려져?
dialogue_lines.en_text: How's the coverage? Does it cover blemishes well, too?

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 웬만한 건 가려지는데 턱 쪽에는 아직 조금 올라와.
dialogue_lines.en_text: It covers most things, but I'm still breaking out a little around my chin.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 새 제품이 안 맞을 수도 있으니까 성분을 한번 확인해 봐.
dialogue_lines.en_text: The new product might not agree with you, so check the ingredients.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 그러게. 향이 강해서 그런지 피부가 좀 예민해진 느낌이야.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Good point. My skin feels a little irritated, maybe because the fragrance is strong.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 며칠은 쓰지 말고 피부가 가라앉는지 보자.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Stop using it for a few days and see if your skin clears up.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 일단 보습만 꾸준히 할게. 괜히 이것저것 더 바르면 악화될 것 같아.
dialogue_lines.en_text: I'll just keep up with moisturizer for now. Adding more products might make it worse.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 좋은 생각이야. 계속 트러블이 나면 피부과에 가 보는 게 낫겠어.
dialogue_lines.en_text: That sounds sensible. If you keep breaking out, you should probably see a dermatologist.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 맞아. 뽀송한 것도 좋지만 피부가 편안한 게 먼저지.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Exactly. A matte finish is nice, but comfortable skin comes first.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 발표 잘될 거야. 시작하기도 전에 망할 거라고 계속 말하지 마.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Your presentation will go fine. Don't keep saying it'll be a disaster before it even starts.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 알아. 말이 씨가 된다고 하잖아. 나도 괜히 불안해져서 그래.
dialogue_lines.en_text: I know. They say you can speak things into existence. I'm just getting in my own head.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 걱정은 이해하지만 준비 많이 했잖아. 핵심만 차분히 짚으면 돼.
dialogue_lines.en_text: I get why you're worried, but you've prepared well. Just take the main points one at a time.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 예상 못 한 질문이 나오면 어떡하지? 그게 제일 걸려.
dialogue_lines.en_text: What if they bring up something I haven't prepared for? That's what worries me most.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 모르는 건 확인하고 답하겠다고 하면 돼. 괜히 아는 척할 필요 없어.
dialogue_lines.en_text: You can say you'll check and get back to them. There's no need to pretend you know everything.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 그 말 들으니 좀 낫다. 내가 혼자 일을 너무 크게 만들었네.
dialogue_lines.en_text: That makes me feel better. I was making it bigger than it needed to be.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 그러니까 시작도 전에 초 치지 말자. 아직 일어나지도 않았어.
dialogue_lines.en_text: So don't rain on your own parade before it starts. It hasn't even happened yet.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 맞아. 팀원들 앞에서 괜히 재뿌리는 말은 안 할게.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Right. I'll stop putting a damper on things in front of the team.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 끝나고 커피 마시면서 어땠는지 같이 정리해 보자. 잠깐 숨 돌릴 시간도 갖고.
dialogue_lines.en_text: After it's over, let's get coffee, give ourselves a chance to decompress, and talk through how it went.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 좋아. 최악을 상상하기보다 내가 준비한 걸 믿어 볼게.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Deal. I'll trust the work I put in instead of imagining the worst.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 그 재킷 입어 봐. 어깨선이 네 체형에 딱 맞을 것 같아.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Try that jacket on. The shoulders look like they'd work perfectly on you.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 입어 보니까 허리는 딱 맞는데 소매가 조금 길어.
dialogue_lines.en_text: The waist fits just right, but the sleeves are a little long.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 그래도 핏이 살아. 어깨가 정리돼 보여서 훨씬 세련됐어.
dialogue_lines.en_text: It still gives you a great shape. The clean shoulders make it look much sharper.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 이 셔츠랑도 찰떡이네. 새 바지를 살 필요는 없겠다.
dialogue_lines.en_text: It goes perfectly with this shirt, too. I don't need to get new trousers after all.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 평소 입는 바지 가져왔어. 색도 잘 맞는지 같이 보자.
dialogue_lines.en_text: I brought the trousers you usually wear. Let's see how the colors look together.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 가격은 좀 있네. 세일할 때까지 기다릴까?
dialogue_lines.en_text: It's a bit pricey, though. Maybe I should wait for a sale.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 자주 입을 거면 괜찮은 투자일 수도 있어. 소재도 확인해 봐.
dialogue_lines.en_text: If you'll wear it a lot, it might be worth the investment. Check the fabric, too.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 울 혼방이네. 오래 입어도 모양이 잘 유지될 것 같아.
dialogue_lines.en_text: It's a wool blend. I think it'll keep its shape well.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 소매 수선도 가능한지 물어봐. 줄이면 완벽하겠다.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Ask if they can alter the sleeves. A shorter length would make it perfect.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 그럼 한 번 더 입어 보고 결정할게. 확실히 잘 어울리긴 해.
dialogue_lines.en_text: I'll try it on once more and decide. It definitely looks good on me.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 회의실 예약이 바뀌었다며? 우리 이제 다른 층으로 가야 해.
dialogue_lines.en_text: I heard the meeting room changed. We have to go to another floor now.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 응, 공지가 아침에 왔어. 내가 전달하는 걸 깜빡했네.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Yeah, the notice came this morning. I forgot to pass it along.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 그런 걸 진작 말했어야지. 자료까지 다 여기로 가져왔잖아.
dialogue_lines.en_text: You should've told me earlier. I brought all the materials over here.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 미안해. 다른 일에 정신이 팔려서 완전히 놓쳤어.
dialogue_lines.en_text: I'm sorry. I got caught up with something else and completely missed it.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 지금이라도 알았으니 옮기면 돼. 새 방 위치는 확인했어?
dialogue_lines.en_text: At least we know now. Did you check where the new room is?

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 응, 5층이야. 엘리베이터에서 내리면 바로 보여.
dialogue_lines.en_text: It's on the fifth floor. It'll be easy to find when we get off the elevator.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 다음부터 공지 오면 바로 공유해 줘. 막판에 알면 준비가 꼬여.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Next time, pass the notice along as soon as it comes in. Last-minute changes throw everything off.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 맞아. 지금 얘기해 봤자 뒷북이지만 캘린더도 확인해 둘게.
dialogue_lines.en_text: You're right. It's a little late to bring it up now, but I'll check the calendar, too.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 그럼 노트북은 내가 들게. 너는 프린트물을 챙겨.
dialogue_lines.en_text: I'll take the laptop. You grab the printouts.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 알았어. 다음엔 먼저 알려서 이런 일 없게 할게.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Got it. I'll give you a heads-up next time so this doesn't happen again.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 어디쯤이야? 예약 시간까지 10분밖에 안 남았어.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Where are you? We only have ten minutes before the reservation.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 미안, 차가 꼼짝도 안 해. 사고 때문에 도로가 완전히 막혔어.
dialogue_lines.en_text: I'm sorry, traffic isn't moving at all. An accident has brought the road to a standstill.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 택시도 같은 길로 오면 늦겠네. 다른 경로로 갈 수 있는지 봤어?
dialogue_lines.en_text: A cab will be late if it takes the same route. Have you checked for another way?

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 우회로는 찾았는데 차가 꼼짝도 안 해서 아직 발이 묶였어.
dialogue_lines.en_text: The app found a detour, but traffic is still holding me up.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 식당에 전화해서 15분 늦는다고 말해 둘게.
dialogue_lines.en_text: I'll call the restaurant and let them know we'll be fifteen minutes late.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 고마워. 차가 움직이기 시작하면 바로 연락하고 곧 갈게.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Thanks. I'll give you a call and come straight over as soon as traffic starts moving.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 늦는다고 무리해서 운전하지 마. 안전하게 와.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Don't rush or drive recklessly. I know you're running late, but get here safely.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 알았어. 앱에는 7시 20분쯤 도착한다고 나와.
dialogue_lines.en_text: I will. The app says I'll get there around 7:20.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 그럼 내가 먼저 들어가서 자리를 잡아 둘게.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Then I'll go in first and get us a table.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 고마워. 도착하면 음료부터 주문해도 돼.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Thanks. Feel free to get a drink before I arrive.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 이 날씨에도 아이스커피 마실 거야? 진짜 얼죽아네.
dialogue_lines.en_text: You're getting iced coffee in this weather? You really are committed to iced drinks.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 응, 따뜻한 건 딱히 당기지 않아. 얼음 많이 넣어 달라고 할게.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Yeah, I don't feel like having anything hot. I'll ask them to make it extra iced.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 난 디카페인 라테로 할게. 오후에 마시면 잠이 안 오더라.
dialogue_lines.en_text: I'll get a decaf latte. Caffeine in the afternoon keeps me up.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 우유는 일반 우유로 괜찮아? 대체 우유도 있던데.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Are you okay with regular milk? They have alternatives, too.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 오늘은 괜찮아. 시럽은 빼고 만들어 달라고 할게.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Regular is fine today. I'll ask them to make it without syrup.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 케이크도 하나 시킬까? 나눠 먹으면 달콤하게 입가심하기 좋겠다.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Should we get a slice of cake, too? We could share it as a little something sweet.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 좋아. 너무 달지 않은 걸로 골라 보자.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Sure. Let's go with something that's not too sweet.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 이 레몬 타르트는 어때? 리뷰를 확인했는데 평이 좋네.
dialogue_lines.en_text: How about this lemon tart? I checked the reviews, and people seem to love it.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 그걸로 하자. 커피랑도 잘 맞을 것 같아.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Let's get that one. It should go well with the coffee.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 내가 주문할게. 자리 잡고 있어.
dialogue_lines.en_text: I'll place the order. Go ahead and get us a table.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 싱크대에 설거지가 계속 쌓이네. 오늘은 같이 치우자.
dialogue_lines.en_text: The dishes keep piling up in the sink. Let's clear them out together today.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 귀찮아 죽겠어. 하루 종일 회의해서 아무것도 하기 싫어.
dialogue_lines.en_text: I'm so over it. I've been in meetings all day and don't feel like doing a thing.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 나도 피곤해. 그래도 손 하나 안 까딱하면 내일 더 힘들어져.
dialogue_lines.en_text: I'm tired, too. But if neither of us lifts a finger, it'll be worse tomorrow.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 그럼 내가 설거지할게. 너는 음식물 쓰레기만 버려 줘.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Then I'll do the dishes. Could you just take out the food waste?

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 좋아. 끝나면 바닥도 한번 쓸자. 부스러기가 꽤 보여.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Sure. Let's clear the crumbs off the floor afterward. There are quite a few.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 바닥은 주말에 하자. 오늘은 꼭 필요한 것만 끝내자.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Let's leave the floor for the weekend. We can just get the essentials done tonight.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 알았어. 세제도 거의 다 썼으니 장바구니에 넣어 둘게.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Okay. We're almost out of detergent, so I'll put it on the shopping list.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 고마워. 끝나면 내가 간단히 저녁 만들어 볼게.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Thanks. Once we're done, I'll make us something simple for dinner.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 그 말 들으니 힘이 나네. 음악 틀어 놓고 빨리 끝내자.
dialogue_lines.en_text: That gives me a little motivation. Let's put some music on and get it over with.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 좋아. 20분만 집중하면 집이 훨씬 깔끔해질 거야.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Deal. If we focus for twenty minutes, the place will feel much cleaner.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 오늘 몸이 좀 찌뿌둥해 보여. 잠은 제대로 잤어?
dialogue_lines.en_text: You look a little stiff and out of sorts today. Did you sleep okay?

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 몸살 기운이 있는 것 같아. 어젯밤부터 몸이 으슬으슬했어.
dialogue_lines.en_text: I think I'm coming down with something. I've had chills since last night.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 열은 재 봤어? 그냥 피곤한 건지 확인해 보자.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Have you checked your temperature? Let's see if it's more than just fatigue.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 아직 안 쟀어. 목도 조금 아픈 것 같아.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Not yet. I think my throat is starting to hurt, too.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 일단 물 마시고 따뜻하게 있어. 오늘 운동은 쉬는 게 낫겠다.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Drink some water and keep warm for now. You should probably skip your workout today.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 맞아. 무리하면 더 오래 갈 것 같아.
dialogue_lines.en_text: You're right. If I push myself, I might be sick for longer.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 필요하면 병원 예약 잡아 줄게. 증상이 심해지는지도 봐.
dialogue_lines.en_text: I can make a doctor's appointment if you need one. Keep an eye on your symptoms.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 고마워. 점심 지나도 열이 나면 바로 갈게.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Thanks. If I still have a fever after lunch, I'll go in.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 오늘 회의는 내가 대신 들어갈게. 넌 일찍 들어가서 쉬어.
dialogue_lines.en_text: I'll take the meeting for you. Head home early and get some rest.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 정말 고마워. 쉬고 나서 상태 알려 줄게.
dialogue_lines.en_text: I really appreciate it. I'll let you know how I feel after I rest.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 이 이어폰 괜찮아 보이는데 가격이 생각보다 높네.
dialogue_lines.en_text: These earbuds look decent, but they're more expensive than I expected.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 리뷰부터 확인하자. 급하게 사면 바가지 쓰기 쉬워.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Let's check the reviews first. It's easy to overpay when you rush into a purchase.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 평점은 좋은데 배터리가 오래 안 간다는 말이 꽤 있어.
dialogue_lines.en_text: The rating is good, but quite a few people say the battery doesn't last.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 그럼 다른 모델도 보자. 할인 코드까지 적용되는 곳이 있네.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Then let's look at another model. One store even takes a discount code.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 이건 가격이 조금 낮고 보증 기간도 길어서 오래 쓸 수 있겠어.
dialogue_lines.en_text: This one's cheaper, comes with a longer warranty, and should keep working for years.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 기능도 충분해서 가격 대비 가성비가 정말 좋네. 굳이 비싼 걸 살 필요 없겠다.
dialogue_lines.en_text: It has all the features we need, which makes it excellent value. No point paying more.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 배송비도 확인해 봐. 결제 단계에서 붙는 경우가 있더라.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Check the shipping cost, too. Sometimes they add it at checkout.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 무료 배송이래. 둘이 같이 사면 더 할인받을 수도 있어.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Shipping is free. We might get an additional discount if we buy two.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 난 하나면 충분해. 필요 이상으로 사면 결국 돈만 나가.
dialogue_lines.en_text: One is enough for me. Buying more than we need just wastes money.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 동의해. 가격 비교까지 했으니 이제 안심하고 주문하자.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Agreed. We've compared prices, so let's go ahead and get them.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 휴대폰이 또 먹통이야? 화면이 아예 안 켜지네.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Did your phone get stuck again? The screen won't turn on at all.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 응, 앱도 계속 버벅거려. 저장 공간이 꽉 찬 것 같아.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Yeah, the apps keep lagging, too. I think the storage is full.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 최근에 업데이트했어? 업데이트 뒤부터 이러는 것 같아.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Did you update it recently? It seems to have started after the update.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 어제 했어. 재부팅하면 잠깐 괜찮다가 다시 느려져.
dialogue_lines.en_text: I did yesterday. Restarting helps for a bit, then it slows down again.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 사진 백업부터 확인하고 불필요한 파일을 지워 보자.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Let's check that your photos are backed up and clear out files you don't need.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 좋아. 그런데 전원 버튼도 가끔 반응이 없어.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Okay. The power button sometimes stops responding, too.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 전원 버튼을 길게 눌러 봐. 강제로 재시작될 수도 있어.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Try holding the power button down. It might force a restart.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 보증 기간이 남았는지 확인할게. 무상 수리면 좋겠다.
dialogue_lines.en_text: I'll check whether it's still under warranty. Hopefully the repair is covered.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 수리 맡기기 전에 중요한 자료는 따로 저장해 둬.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Save your important files somewhere else before you take it in for repair.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 알았어. 당분간은 필요한 앱만 켜서 써야겠다.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Will do. I'll keep only the apps I need open for now.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 영수증 받았어? 오늘은 각자 먹은 것만 계산하면 될까?
dialogue_lines.en_text: Did you get the receipt? Should we each pay for what we ordered?

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 다 같이 나눠 먹었으니까 그냥 똑같이 나누자.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Since we shared everything, let's split the bill evenly.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 좋아. 내가 계산하고 각자 정산 금액을 단체 채팅방에 알려 줄게.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Works for me. I'll take care of the bill and give everyone a breakdown of what they owe in the group chat.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 잠깐, 오늘은 내가 쏜다고 했잖아. 승진 축하 자리니까.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Wait, I said dinner was on me tonight. We're celebrating my promotion.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 고맙긴 한데 금액이 꽤 나왔어. 정말 괜찮겠어?
dialogue_lines.en_text: That's generous of you, but this is a pretty big bill. Are you sure?

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 괜찮아. 오늘은 내가 내고 다음에 네가 커피 사.
dialogue_lines.en_text: It's fine. I'll cover dinner, and you can get coffee next time.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 그럼 음료 값은 내가 낼게. 그 정도는 받아 줘.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Then let me take care of the drinks. At least let me do that.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 좋아. 대신 영수증은 내가 챙길게.
dialogue_lines.en_text: All right. I'll keep the receipt, then.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 정산은 깔끔해졌네. 다음 모임 계획도 세우자.
dialogue_lines.en_text: That settles it. Let's make a plan for the next get-together, too.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 좋지. 다음엔 부담 없이 각자 계산하자.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Sounds good. Next time, let's keep it simple and pay our own way.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 오늘 후텁지근하네. 비 오기 직전처럼 공기가 무거워.
dialogue_lines.en_text: It's muggy today. The air feels heavy, like it's about to rain.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 아침엔 선선해서 긴팔 입었는데 지금은 너무 덥다.
dialogue_lines.en_text: It was cool this morning, so I wore long sleeves. Now I'm overheating.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 요즘 일교차가 크니까 겉옷 하나 챙기는 게 낫겠어.
dialogue_lines.en_text: The temperature swings a lot these days, so it's worth bringing a light jacket.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 맞아. 해가 지면 날씨가 금방 쌀쌀해지더라.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Exactly. It tends to turn chilly by the time I leave work.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 일기예보 확인했어? 저녁에 소나기 온대.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Did you check the forecast? It says there'll be a shower this evening.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 안 봤어. 우산도 안 가져왔는데 큰일이네.
dialogue_lines.en_text: I didn't. I haven't brought an umbrella, either. That's not ideal.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 내 여분 우산 가져가. 대신 내일 돌려줘.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Take my spare umbrella. Just bring it back tomorrow.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 고마워. 퇴근길에 편의점에서 하나 더 사 둘게.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Thanks. I'll pick one up at the convenience store on my way home.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 바람이 불기 시작하네. 밖에 나갈 때 조심해.
dialogue_lines.en_text: The wind is picking up. Be careful when you head out.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 응. 날씨가 갑자기 바뀌니까 겹쳐 입는 게 답이야.
dialogue_lines.en_text: I will. With the weather changing so quickly, layering is the way to go.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 새 팀장 온다는 소문 들었어? 아직 공식 발표는 없대.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Have you heard the rumor about a new team lead? Apparently, nothing's official yet.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 들었는데 확인되기 전까지는 믿지 않으려고.
dialogue_lines.en_text: I have, but I'm trying not to believe it until someone checks the facts.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 나도 귀가 얇아서 누가 말하면 금방 믿게 돼. 가끔은 나도 내가 그러는 걸 알아차려.
dialogue_lines.en_text: I'm pretty gullible when it comes to rumors; I catch myself believing whatever I hear.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 그러니까. 출처가 어딘지 확인하고 괜히 퍼뜨리지 말자.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Exactly. Let's check where it came from and not pass it around for no reason.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 사실 인사팀에서 먼저 얘기해 줬어. 너만 알고 있어.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Actually, HR gave me a heads-up first. Keep it to yourself for now.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 알았어. 더 자세한 얘기는 아직 안 나온 거지?
dialogue_lines.en_text: Got it. They haven't shared any more details yet, right?

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 응, 확정된 일정만 들었어. 이름은 아직 모르고.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Right. I only heard the confirmed timeline. I don't know who it is yet.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 그럼 아무한테도 말 안 할게. 잘못 전해지면 곤란하니까.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Then I won't tell anyone. It could get messy if the story gets distorted.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 고마워. 공식 공지가 나오면 그때 같이 확인하자.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Thanks. Let's check together once the official announcement comes out.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 좋아. 그전엔 소문에 휘둘리지 말고 조용히 있자.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Sounds good. Let's keep quiet and not get carried away by speculation.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 운동 등록했다며? 이번엔 작심삼일로 끝나는 거 아니지?
dialogue_lines.en_text: I heard you joined a gym. This isn't going to be another three-day phase, is it?

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 이번엔 주 3회만 꾸준히 가려고. 그 계획은 끝까지 지킬 거야.
dialogue_lines.en_text: I'm aiming for three times a week, and I'll stand by that plan. If I overdo it, I won't keep it up.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 좋은 계획이네. 같이 가면 서로 꾸준히 하게 도와줄 수 있겠다.
dialogue_lines.en_text: That's a solid plan. We could help each other stick with it if we go together.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 그러자. 러닝머신만 뛰면 지루하니까 근력 운동도 섞을 거야.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Let's do that. Running on a treadmill gets boring, so I'll mix in strength training.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 운동복 입으니까 벌써 좀 폼이 나는데?
dialogue_lines.en_text: You've got the look already just wearing the workout gear.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 겉모습만 그래. 스쿼트 몇 개 하면 바로 힘들걸.
dialogue_lines.en_text: That's just the outfit. A few squats and I'll be struggling.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 첫날부터 기록 세우려 하지 말고 자세부터 잡자.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Don't try to set records on day one. Let's focus on getting your form right.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 알았어. 운동 끝나면 스트레칭도 빼먹지 말아야지.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Got it. I'll make sure not to skip the stretching afterward.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 맞아. 통증이 날카롭게 느껴지면 바로 멈춰.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Right. Stop if you feel any sharp pain.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 좋아. 이번엔 기록보다 꾸준히 하는 걸 목표로 할게.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Deal. This time, I'll focus on consistency, not hitting a number.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 벌써 11시 반이야. 우리 막차 탈 수 있을까?
dialogue_lines.en_text: It's already half past eleven. Do you think we can still catch the last train?

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 앱에는 5분 뒤에 온다고 나와. 서두르면 탈 수 있을 것 같아.
dialogue_lines.en_text: The app says it's due in five minutes. We can make it if we hurry.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 역까지 뛰어가진 말자. 계단에서 넘어지면 더 곤란해.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Let's not run all the way to the station. We don't need anyone falling on the stairs.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 맞아. 놓치면 택시를 타야 하는데 요금이 꽤 나올 거야.
dialogue_lines.en_text: True. If we miss it, we'll need to take a cab, and it'll cost a lot.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 택시 부를게. 기사님께 중간에 편의점 앞에서 내려 달라고 하면 돼.
dialogue_lines.en_text: I'll book a cab. We can ask the driver to drop us off by the convenience store on the way.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 좋아. 거기서 집까지는 걸어서 금방이야.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Good. It's just a short walk home from there.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 차가 곧 온대. 큰길 쪽으로 나가서 기다리자.
dialogue_lines.en_text: The cab is coming. Let's wait out by the main road.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 기사님한테 정확한 위치를 보냈어?
dialogue_lines.en_text: Did you send the driver the exact pickup location?

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 응, 출구 번호까지 보냈어. 여기로 바로 올 거야.
dialogue_lines.en_text: I did, including the exit number. They should come straight here.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 다행이다. 다음엔 막차 시간 전에 먼저 확인하자.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Good. Next time, let's check the last-train schedule before it gets this late.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 선물 고르는 거 도와줄래? 그 친구 취향이 좀 까탈스러워.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Can you help me pick a gift? They're pretty particular about what they like.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 지난번에 좋아한 건 뭐였어? 그걸 기준으로 보면 되지.
dialogue_lines.en_text: What did they like last time? We can use that as a starting point.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 작은 독립 서점에서 산 노트를 정말 좋아했어.
dialogue_lines.en_text: They loved the notebook I got from that little independent bookstore.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 그럼 문구류나 책갈피가 취향저격일 수 있겠다.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Then stationery or a bookmark might be right up their alley.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 너무 뻔한 선물처럼 보이지 않을까?
dialogue_lines.en_text: Wouldn't that feel a little too predictable?

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 손으로 만든 책갈피를 찾아봐. 특별하면서도 부담스럽지 않을 거야.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Look for a handmade bookmark. It'll feel thoughtful without being over the top.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 좋네. 색은 차분한 걸로 고르면 되겠다.
dialogue_lines.en_text: That's a good idea. I can keep the color understated.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 포장도 같이 해 주는지 확인해 봐. 선물 느낌이 더 살 거야.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Check if they offer gift wrapping. It'll make it feel more special.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 가격도 괜찮고, 진짜 마음에 들어 할 것 같아.
dialogue_lines.en_text: It's reasonably priced, and I think they'll genuinely love it.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 그럼 그걸로 하자. 네가 골라서 더 의미 있겠다.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Then go with that. It'll mean more because you picked it out.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 택배 도착 알림 왔어? 오늘 꼭 받아야 하는데.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Did you get a delivery notification? I really need that package today.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 응, 배송 완료래. 택배 기사가 문 앞에 두고 갔다고 나와.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Yeah, it says the courier put it by the front door and dropped it off.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 사진도 있어? 가끔 옆집 문 앞에 두고 가더라.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Is there a delivery photo? Sometimes they leave it at the neighbor's door.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 사진 보니까 우리 집 맞아. 내가 내려가서 가져올게.
dialogue_lines.en_text: The photo looks like our place. I'll go down and bring it up.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 고마워. 상자 찌그러졌는지도 확인해 줘.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Thanks. Could you check whether the box is damaged, too?

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 겉은 괜찮아 보여. 안에 있는 물건도 확인해 볼게.
dialogue_lines.en_text: The outside looks fine. I'll check the item inside, too.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 색이 주문한 거랑 다르면 바로 반품 처리해야 해.
dialogue_lines.en_text: If the color doesn't match what we ordered, we'll have to arrange a return right away.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 다행히 맞네. 그래도 구성품이 하나 빠진 것 같아.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Luckily, the color is right. But I think one of the accessories is missing.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 구매 내역이랑 포장 목록을 확인해 보자. 고객센터에 연락할 수도 있어.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Let's check the order details and packing list. We may need to contact customer service.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 사진 찍어서 문의 남길게. 답변 오면 같이 확인하자.
dialogue_lines.en_text: I'll take a photo and send them a message. We can check their reply together.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 이번 주말엔 뭐 할 거야? 날씨도 괜찮다던데.
dialogue_lines.en_text: What are you doing this weekend? I heard the weather should be nice.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 아무 계획 없어. 이번 주는 너무 바빠서 그냥 방콕하고 싶어.
dialogue_lines.en_text: I have no plans. This week was exhausting, so I just want to stay in.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 가끔은 그게 최고지. 알람 없이 늘어지게 자고 싶다.
dialogue_lines.en_text: A slow morning feels like exactly what I need. I'd love to sleep in with no alarm.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 나도. 늦게 일어나서 배달 음식 시켜 먹고 싶어.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Same here. I want to get up late and order something in.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 밀린 드라마도 보고 휴대폰은 좀 내려놓자.
dialogue_lines.en_text: We could catch up on that series and put our phones away for a while.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 좋아. 소파에서 담요 덮고 하루 종일 있어도 되겠다.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Perfect. We can stay on the couch under a blanket all day.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 집이 너무 어질러져 있으면 쉬는 기분이 안 나니까 가볍게 치우자.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Let's do a quick tidy-up first. I can't relax when the place is too messy.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 정리는 딱 10분만 하고 그다음엔 아무것도 안 하는 걸로.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Let's keep the cleanup to ten minutes, and then we're officially doing nothing.

dialogue_lines.speaker: A
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 좋아. 커피 내려 놓을 테니 너는 간식 좀 골라 줘.
dialogue_lines.en_text: Deal. I'll make coffee, and you pick out some snacks.

dialogue_lines.speaker: B
dialogue_lines.ko_text: 완벽한 주말이네. 월요일에 다시 기운 차리면 되지.
dialogue_lines.en_text: That sounds like a perfect weekend. Let's take it easy and recharge before Monday.
